digest.component_or_area: MCP HMAC secret infrastructure (SSM, deployment automation)
propositions: MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY and /rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key are produced in terraform, transported into environment files, and documented in runbooks and setup guides, but have zero runtime consumers in application code.

The secret's stated purpose (verdict signing) was superseded by ADR 0049, which replaced symmetric HMAC signing with asymmetric Ed25519 operation certificates; current verdict signing uses the op-cert key, not this HMAC secret.
Removing the orphaned secret requires atomic deletion from both the terraform SSM slot and the two transport scripts (user_data.sh and fetch-secrets.sh) to avoid boot-time fetch failures.

Removal eliminates toil (unnecessary secret rotation and restore procedures), eliminates audit noise, and removes a misleading infrastructure signal that contradicts the current op-cert security model.
No supported rollback scenario re-introduces HMAC verdict signing; the rollback cost is manual if ever needed, but the removal consequence for current deployments is nil (no consumer breaks).
